name: Kin Island Sky Pillar & Rayquaza
summary: With both Groudon and Kyogre awakened, speak to the knowledgeable elder in Kin Island's square, who escorts you to the harbor and pilots a chartered vessel to the ancient Sky Pillar. Enter the colossal stone tower and ascend through all five treacherous floors. High-level wild Metang, Dusclops, Mawile, and Ariados inhabit the ruined platforms. Reach the cloudswept pinnacle to confront the master of the skies, Rayquaza (Lv. 70). With its Air Lock ability suppressing all atmospheric weather, deploy Lapras's 4x STAB Ice Beam to bring the legendary dragon low and secure its capture.
